title: 第25章 赌哥叶峰王灵根第26章 地阶残卷雷功法
content_zh:
;;
走进藏书阁的李观棋心底还是有些奇怪。
为什么实力极强的隐世高人，就这么明目张胆的坐在藏书阁门口。
反倒是他觉得是个高人的扫地人，结果就是一个废人。
藏书阁内部空间极高，而且空气十分干燥。
看来也是用了一些什么手段来保证功法秘籍不被潮气侵染。
一层之中空旷无比，只有摆放的密密麻麻的书架，每一个书架上都标注了是哪一类的功法。
但是此时一层之中只有零散的十几位门中弟子在挑选。
等他上到二层的时候，明显感觉到这一层的藏书数量已经急剧下降了。
只有零散的十几个书架，上面的人也只有两三个人，其中恰好就有先前和他搭话的师兄。
那人一看到到李观棋就热情的招了招手笑道：“师弟，雷系功法在这边有几部很不错的。”
“还是黄级上品的功夫，十分适合你。”
李观棋有些尴尬的指了指楼上，笑道：“谢谢师兄了，不过我要去三楼。”
那人的手僵硬在半空中，他足足攒了一年多的宗门积分，才攒够了一千五百点上来二层。
而三层的积分则是最低要求都要三千！
李观棋或许是看出了他的疑惑，连忙说道：“师兄你误会了，我没有那么多积分。”
听闻此话，青年的脸上这才露出一抹微笑，轻声说道：“我就说嘛。”
“师弟才刚刚入门，怎么可能有那么多积分直接上三楼。”
“一楼好一点的功法也不过三五百积分，同样也不错，二层最低都是一千积分，你可以去楼下东南角那边看看。”
李观棋实在是有些不想伤害这位师兄的内心，实在是他太热情了。

无奈之下李观棋耸了耸肩说道：“宗主破例让我上去一趟挑选。”
二人之间的对话早就引起了其他几人的注意。
当听到少年这么说的时候，几人纷纷转头望向那天木峰的弟子。
只见他一个大男人此时眼泪汪汪，轻咬下唇，眼神之中满是幽怨的看着那道上楼的背影。
李观棋刚走上三楼，便被一道光幕拦住了去路。
上方萤石散发出一股柔和的光芒射向李观棋腰间玉简。
验证无误后光幕打开了一道缺口，李观棋顺势走了上了三楼。
当走上第三层的时候李观棋彻底被震惊了。
因为整个第三层之中都没有一个书架，空荡荡的第三层只有无数的灵光在空中乱飞。
而整个第三层之中竟然还有另外一个人存在。
一个身材修长的少年，面容英俊无比，一头的金发尤为惹眼。
而此人就是同样和他一起入宗的弟子！
少年剑眉星目，五官立体，鼻梁处有一颗痣十分扎眼。
这让他整个人气质看起来有些妖异。
少年的眼底闪过一抹诧异之色，显然他也没想到这个时候竟然会有人同样来到了第三层。
对方缓缓走到李观棋的身前轻声笑道：“你好，天金峰叶峰。”
李观棋看着长相俊美的少年不由得摸了摸鼻子，心中暗道。
“长得这么骚包么…这家伙肯定在天水峰那帮女弟子里面很受欢迎啊。”
李观棋心中如此想到，可脸上还是笑道：“天雷峰，李观棋。”
叶峰笑了笑说道：“听说过你，圣品灵根，好生羡慕啊。”

“我这个觉醒了王品灵根的人在你后面都没有掀起一点风浪来。”
李观棋表面笑了笑，心中则是撇了撇嘴。

Li Guanqi felt a little strange when he walked into the library.
Why is this extremely powerful hidden master sitting so blatantly at the door of the library?
On the contrary, he thought he was a superior sweeper, but he turned out to be a useless person.
The interior space of the library is extremely high and the air is very dry.
It seems that some means have been used to ensure that the skill secrets are not contaminated by moisture.
The first floor was extremely empty, with only densely packed bookshelves, and each bookshelf was marked with its type of exercise.
But at this time, there are only a dozen or so scattered disciples on the first floor who are choosing.
When he reached the second floor, he clearly felt that the number of books on this floor had dropped sharply.
There were only a dozen scattered bookshelves, and there were only two or three people on them, and among them happened to be the senior brother who had talked to him before.
As soon as the man saw Li Guanqi, he waved enthusiastically and said with a smile: "Junior brother, there are some very good thunder skills here."
"It's still a top-grade yellow-level kung fu, which is very suitable for you."
Li Guanqi pointed to the upstairs with some embarrassment and said with a smile: "Thank you, senior brother, but I have to go to the third floor."
The man's hand was frozen in mid-air. He had accumulated sect points for more than a year before he had enough sect points to reach the second floor.
The minimum requirement for points for the third level is 3,000!
Li Guanqi may have noticed his doubts and said quickly: "Brother, you misunderstood. I don't have that many points."
After hearing this, a smile appeared on the young man's face and he said softly: "I'll just say it."
"Junior brother has just started, how can he have so many points to go directly to the third floor?"
"The better techniques on the first floor only have three to five hundred points, which are also pretty good. The lowest points on the second floor are one thousand points. You can go to the southeast corner downstairs and have a look."
Li Guanqi really didn't want to hurt this senior brother because he was too enthusiastic.
In desperation, Li Guanqi shrugged and said, "The sect master made an exception and asked me to go up and make a selection."
The conversation between the two had already attracted the attention of several other people.
When they heard what the young man said, several people turned to look at Mufeng's disciples that day.
I saw him, a grown man, with tears in his eyes, biting his lower lip, and looking at the figure walking upstairs with resentment in his eyes.
As soon as Li Guanqi walked up to the third floor, he was blocked by a light curtain.
The fluorite above emits a soft light towards the jade slip on Li Guanqi's waist.
After verification, the light curtain opened a gap, and Li Guanqi walked up to the third floor.
When he walked onto the third floor, Li Guanqi was completely shocked.
Because there is not a single bookshelf in the entire third floor, the empty third floor has only countless spiritual lights flying in the air.
And there is actually another person in the entire third level.
A slender young man with an extremely handsome face, and his blond hair is particularly eye-catching.
And this person is the disciple who also joined the sect with him!
The young man has sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, three-dimensional facial features, and a very eye-catching mole on the bridge of his nose.
This makes his whole personality look a little weird.
A look of surprise flashed through the young man's eyes. Apparently he didn't expect that someone would come to the third floor at this time.
The other party slowly walked up to Li Guanqi and smiled softly: "Hello, Tianjin Peak Ye Feng."
Li Guanqi looked at the handsome young man and couldn't help but touch his nose, thinking to himself.
"Does he look so coquettish... This guy must be very popular among the female disciples at Tianshui Peak."
Li Guanqi thought this in his heart, but he still smiled on his face and said: "Tianlei Peak, Li Guanqi."
Ye Feng smiled and said: "I've heard of you, Holy Grade Spiritual Root, I'm so envious."
"I, a person who has awakened Wangpin's spiritual roots, haven't caused any trouble behind you."
Li Guanqi smiled on the outside, but curled his lips inwardly.
